evidence.summary: scripts/inventory.py walk: 2 manifests, 1 Dockerfile, 2 listeners, 1 secret-pattern hit, CI actions pinned to SHAs; coverage complete for walked files

Runtime inventory lists no Tailscale / mesh client, no PeopleSoft or PeopleTools path, and no desktop browser or host-kernel inventory. service-a-runtime is a PHP-FPM worker, not a mesh node, PeopleSoft host or desktop endpoint
Inventory lists no gmo_onamae_hints: no Onamae nameserver, zone or Desktop Cloud config on the walked repository
Image labels: base php 8.3.30 FPM variant; OCI revision label matches source SHA
Owner-run read-only query inside a running worker: php-fpm reports 8.3.30, SAPI fpm-fcgi; package metadata shows no vendor backport for the 2026-10-21 CVEs
Effective pool config: session.upload_progress.enabled=1, memory_limit finite, post_max_size 64M
OSV-Scanner (pinned, checksum verified) on both lockfiles: one advisory for a package present only in tools/qa/composer.lock
Compose file publishes a metrics listener on 0.0.0.0:9253 with no auth, besides FPM on 9000
Secret-pattern hit (assigned_secret) at config/legacy.env line 3; value not recorded
Gateway enforces SSO, but the admin export route checks only that a session exists, not the caller's export permission
Same-model adversarial pass suggests the webhook fetcher might allow server-side requests to internal hosts; no trace or test
Image scanner not available in this environment
Tenant audit-log export returned HTTP 403 for the read-only audit role
Tenant admin export with the read-only audit role: MFA required for all users, access tokens last 60 minutes, third-party app grants listed

findings.title: Served PHP 8.3.30 FPM build predates the 8.3.36 security release
findings.notes: FPM path per the advisories: OOM corruption is supported by source analysis with no complete FPM exploit shown; the stale-state session lifecycle path was validated against FPM. Conditions recorded, no exploit attempted. Session upload progress is enabled (EV-004).

findings.title: Vulnerable package in the QA tool lockfile
findings.notes: Test-only manifest. Whether the image excludes it stays unproven until CHK-03 runs.

findings.title: Unauthenticated metrics listener bound to all interfaces
Credential-shaped value committed in config/legacy.env
findings.notes: Value withheld. Owner notified; rotation and revocation need the credential owner.

findings.title: Admin export authorizes any SSO session
findings.notes: SSO authenticates; it does not grant per-user permission downstream.

findings.title: Possible server-side request reach from webhook fetcher
findings.unknown_reason: Only a same-model review raised it; no code trace or isolated test yet.

fix_plan.action: Rebuild the image on a PHP 8.3.36 (or vendor-patched) FPM base; until then consider documented mitigations as risk reduction only, restarting every worker
